title: Austin Faces Power Company Lawsuit
summary:
*   City leaders held a special, private session to address urgent legal matters.
*   Discussions primarily focused on two ongoing lawsuits.
*   A key case involved the City of Austin directly suing Houston Lighting and Power Company.
